shortDescription: Manage a registered Hyperledger Fabric identity

options.name: api_authtype
options.description: C(basic) - Authenticate to the Fabric operations console using basic authentication. You must provide both a valid API key using I(api_key) and API secret using I(api_secret).

options.name: api_endpoint
options.description: The URL for the Fabric operations console.

options.name: api_key
options.description: The API key for the Fabric operations console.

options.name: api_secret
options.description: The API secret for the Fabric operations console. Only required when I(api_authtype) is C(basic).

options.name: api_timeout
options.description: The timeout, in seconds, to use when interacting with the Fabric operations console.

options.name: certificate_authority
options.description: The certificate authority to use to register this identity. You can pass a string, which is the display name of a certificate authority registered with the Fabric operations console. You can also pass a dictionary, which must match the result format of one of the M(certificate_authority_info) or M(certificate_authority) modules.

options.name: enrollment_id
options.description: The enrollment ID, or user name, of the identity to register on the certificate authority.

options.name: enrollment_secret
options.description: The enrollment secret, or password, of an identity to register on the certificate authority. Only required when I(state) is C(present).

options.name: hsm
options.description: The PKCS #11 compliant HSM configuration to use for digital signatures. Only required if the identity specified in I(registrar) was enrolled using an HSM.

options.name: max_enrollments
options.description: The maximum number of times that this identity can be enrolled.

options.name: registrar
options.description: The identity to use when interacting with the certificate authority. You can pass a string, which is the path to the JSON file where the enrolled identity is stored. You can also pass a dict, which must match the result format of one of the M(enrolled_identity_info) or M(enrolled_identity) modules.

options.name: state
options.description: C(absent) - If an identity is registered matching the specified enrollment ID, the identity will be removed. Note that this operation is unsupported by default and must be enabled by the certificate authority. C(present) - Asserts that an identity matching the specified enrollment ID and configuration is registered. If no identity matches the specified enrollment ID, the identity will be created.
